title: ShellBackendAdapter
description: The capability contract that makes the agentic shell backend-abstract: the shell talks to this adapter surface, so GitHub today and sovereign Gitea tomorrow is a CONFIG CHANGE, not a rewrite (the same pattern as goose-adapters' WorkspaceAdapter). A backend manifest declares its base URL, its CI-minted auth model (never a static PAT), and how each shell operation maps to a backend endpoint.

sovereign.description: true when the backend is user-owned (Gitea/Zot), false for GitHub

model.description: secrets minted in CI only — never a laptop PAT

token_ref.description: the CI secret / vault ref the token is minted into (never the token)

capabilities.description: the shell operations this backend implements

consent_purpose.description: the consent-plane purpose this op requires; mutating ops (ship/operate/egress) are consent-gated + governor-approved
